title: Step 22: implement Searcher.update_files
description: TDD step 22. Implement Searcher.update_files(paths: list[str]) -> dict[str, int]. Each path is vault-relative. For each path: compute absolute = vault_root / path; if absolute.exists() AND not filtered out by index=false: read text, chunk_markdown with resolve_for_file, embed all chunks for the file, call store.upsert_file(path, items). If absolute does not exist: call store.upsert_file(path, []) to delete its chunks. If filtered by index=false: skip silently (do not delete — user's choice to ignore). Return {'files': processed, 'chunks': inserted}. Reuse helpers from index_vault where natural (extract a private _process_file helper). Tests: test_update_files_replaces_existing_chunks (seed via index_vault, call update_files on one path with modified content, assert chunks for that path changed but others didn't); test_update_files_deletes_missing_files (seed, delete file from disk, call update_files, assert chunks are gone); test_update_files_skips_index_false_paths.

title: Code review: fix upsert_file delete order and document rowid invariant
description: Staff review 🔴 Must-fix #2. upsert_file (store.py:76-82) relies on implicit chunks.id == vec_chunks.rowid correspondence, undocumented. Delete order: SELECT ids → DELETE vec_chunks by rowid → DELETE chunks. If anyone ever inserts into one table without the other, search silently drops rows. Fix: delete from chunks first (authoritative), then vec_chunks; add module docstring documenting the rowid-correspondence invariant; add a private helper or assertion that enforces paired inserts via _insert_pair only.
close_reason: upsert_file deletes chunks before vec_chunks; module docstring documents the chunks.id=vec_chunks.rowid invariant; regression test locks in the behavior. 19 tests pass, ruff clean.
